description: This Java class `ElasticSearchHookProcessor` implements the `HookProcessor` interface. It processes hooks by sending data to an external URL, which can be configured with content type and URL settings stored in `HookConfiguration` objects. It uses Gson for JSON serialization/deserialization and Retrofit for HTTP requests. The class is annotated as a Spring `@Service` with constructor injection.

classes.name: ElasticSearchHookProcessor
classes.description: A Spring service that processes hooks by forwarding payloads to external URLs based on hook configurations. Implements the `HookProcessor` interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles hook processing by extracting URL and content type from configuration and then sending the payload appropriately.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with the payload to the specified URL, handling JSON or form data as indicated by the content type.
